official_harness_commands.base_agent:
python -m swebench.harness.run_evaluation \
  --dataset_name princeton-nlp/SWE-bench_Verified \
  --split test \
  --predictions_path output/private-swebench/codex-real-smoke-1/base-agent.predictions.jsonl \
  --max_workers 1 \
  --timeout 1800 \
  --run_id tml_base_codex_real_smoke_1 \
  --report_dir evaluation_results

python -m swebench.harness.run_evaluation \
  --dataset_name princeton-nlp/SWE-bench_Verified \

official_harness_commands.mac_arm_note: On macOS ARM, official SWE-bench docs say to add --namespace '' so images build locally.

performance_claim.honest_interpretation: Prediction coverage can be checked, but real-repo performance is unmeasured until both conditions have official SWE-bench harness reports.
